notes.title: Custom World Tool Update + Smaller fixes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44241035/1311a68a1d93fc4be85bff276e5356a0a2acd594.jpg
Custom World tooling
- Press F7 to gain access to a debug slider to jump in the song for debugging.
- Pressing F7 also gives player immortality.
- Able to adjust how much damage projectiles in shoot projectile script. (cruicial for chain-inv projectiles.)

Main game
- More localization fixes.
- Sorting order fixed in battle colosseum.
- Many minor tile fixes
- Victory animation fix
- Wide5 projectiles are only 5wide and not above.

notes.title: Modding update + proofreading
notes.notes:
Custom Worlds
- Finish Battle function so it doesn't require player to defeat enemy and can have other potential win conditions
- Able to Quit Mod from inside a battle.

Main game
- Proofreading.
- Localization updates
- Savepoint sound effect too loud in riley ending.
- Death defiance reset hitcount cleanup.

notes.title: Less than a month until release!
notes.notes:
We got a new trailer (also visible in the store page)

[previewyoutube=mzGP9Itd1M8;full][/previewyoutube]


The mushroom art contest winners are...
EVERYONE GOT IN!
All mushrooms from the contest have been successfully implemented!
Some are a bit of a secret while others jam it out on the dance floor.
There are a total of about 650 custom mushrooms.

Custom world
We are happy to announce that Everhood 2 has a full integration with steam workshop and is possible to create levels that will be accessible inside the game!

We are intending to support creators to be part of Everhood’s funky world as we believe it has the potential to become something extraordinary.

Socials
Make sure to check out X(twitter) or BlueSky for more Everhood news and make sure to WISHLIST if you haven't already!!
